title: Standardize error response format across all gateway handlers
description:
**Bug**: Gateway handlers inconsistently return errors — some use `http.Error()` (plain text), others return JSON objects. The dashboard's `api.ts:120` does `await res.text()` which works for both, but prevents structured error parsing.

**Fix**: Create a helper `writeErrorJSON(w, status, message)` that returns:
```json
{"error": "message", "status": 400}
```
Replace all `http.Error()` calls in gateway handlers with this helper. The dashboard can then optionally parse JSON errors.

**Scope**: This is a large change — consider doing it incrementally. Start with the most user-facing endpoints (jobs, workflows, auth).

**Files**: `core/controlplane/gateway/gateway.go`, `chat.go`, `auth_handlers.go`, `packs.go`, `policy_bundles.go`
definitionOfDone: All error responses return JSON with {error, status} shape
Dashboard api.ts can parse structured errors

implementationPlan.description:
Replace `http.Error(w, ...)` calls in the most user-facing handlers with `writeErrorJSON(w, ...)`. Start with:
- gateway.go: job endpoints (list, get, submit, cancel)
- auth_handlers.go: login, session
- chat.go: get/post chat

Leave less-critical handlers (packs, policies, config) for a follow-up.
Run backend tests and verify dashboard builds.

reopenReason:
DoD item 2 ("Dashboard api.ts can parse structured errors") not met.

The backend writeErrorJSON sends `{"error": "message", "status": 400}` but the dashboard client at `dashboard/src/api/client.ts:86-89` extracts `body.message`, not `body.error`:

```typescript
const msg =
    (body && typeof body === "object" && "message" in body
      ? String((body as Record<string, unknown>).message)
      : null) ?? res.statusText;
```

This means the structured error message is never extracted — it falls back to `res.statusText` (e.g., "Bad Request" instead of the actual error text).

Fix: Change `"message" in body` to check for `"error"` as well:
```typescript
const msg =
    (body && typeof body === "object" && ("error" in body || "message" in body)
      ? String((body as Record<string, unknown>).error ?? (body as Record<string, unknown>).message)
      : null) ?? res.statusText;
```

Note: The plan step-3 modified `dashboard/src/lib/api.ts` (a deleted file). The actual client is `dashboard/src/api/client.ts`.
